name: Omaphones
author: Jacek Becela
description: Battery levels and noise-cancellation control for Bluetooth headphones, in the Omarchy bar. JBL, Sony, Nothing, Soundcore, Xiaomi; battery on anything with Google Fast Pair or BlueZ.

barWidget.description: One icon per connected set, filling with its battery; the panel shows left, right and case, and switches Off / ANC / Ambient — with the ambient level on Sony and Soundcore, ANC strength and low latency on Nothing.

schema.label: Device name or address contains
schema.description: Leave empty to show every connected audio device; set a substring to follow only the matching ones.

schema.label: Read battery over Google Fast Pair
schema.description: Left, right and case levels over the Fast Pair channel. Off: BlueZ's single figure only, and no JBL noise control — its BLE address is announced on this channel. Sony, Nothing, Soundcore and Xiaomi are unaffected: they serve their own channels.

schema.label: Noise cancellation (Off / ANC / Ambient)
schema.description: The MODE row, following changes made on the device too — plus the ambient level on Sony and Soundcore, and the ANC strength and low-latency switch on Nothing. Works on Sony MDR v1 and v2, Nothing, Soundcore, Xiaomi Buds 5 Pro, and some JBL earbuds (JBL needs Fast Pair above). Hidden when the device answers for none.

schema.label: Show a percentage instead of the drawn meters
schema.description: On: the lower earbud's percentage next to the glyph, taking a second bar slot. Off: the levels fill the two halves of one drawn mark. A vertical bar always draws the mark.

schema.label: Hide the widget while nothing is connected
Send a notification at the low battery threshold
Pause media when a device disconnects or comes off your ears
schema.description: Pauses every currently-playing player (via playerctl) when a followed device disconnects (switched off, out of range) and, on headsets with a wear sensor (confirmed on the Sony WH-1000XM6), the moment it comes off your ears while still connected — resuming exactly those players when it goes back on. Needs playerctl installed.
